QuestInfo.name: Pendant of the Spirit
QuestInfo.0: The Empress, who just returned to Maple World, has given a pendant for the explorers to Cassandra. I better talk to her for more information on this.
QuestInfo.1: The Empress, who just returned to Maple World, has given a pendant for the explorers to Cassandra. I better talk to her for more information on this.
QuestInfo.2: Within the black aura of the Black Mage, let's try to find #t4001237#. \n\n#i4001237# #t4001237# #b#c4001237# / 20#k

0.0: Empress Cygnus is back! She came to me and left a Pendant of the Spirit, and I discovered that this pendant actually possesses a secret special power. If you are curious about the kind of power in this pendant, find and ask me in the nearest town!

no.0: Really? You really don't need it? You might regret it later.

1.0: The special power in this pendant is released the moment you equip it. When you wear it, your EXP will increase more than better. Isn't that a great form of blessing? But that's not the only thing. As time goes on, it'll help raise your EXP even more, so take good care of it!
